dailyBrief: In a turbulent week for AI companies, Anthropic faces potential setbacks as Blackstone warns it may not achieve an investment-grade rating following its IPO. Compounding these challenges, an AI startup reportedly hacked Anthropic, exposing sensitive employee information and internal communications, raising concerns about cybersecurity in the sector. Meanwhile, OpenAI has raised less than half of its ambitious $30 billion target, signaling a tightening investment landscape. Additionally, the emergence of malware utilizing large language models to assess victim worth underscores the growing risks associated with AI technologies. These developments highlight the urgent need for robust security measures and investor caution in an increasingly volatile AI market.
